rows.description: A concentration of largely unexcavated archaeological, historic, and living cultural heritage properties.

rows.name: Rani Ki Vav
rows.description: A stepwell located on the banks of Saraswati River. Built as a memorial to a king by his widowed queen.

rows.name: Historic City of Ahmadabad
rows.description: The walled city of Ahmadabad founded in the 15th century. A blend of Hindu, Islamic, and Jain architecture.

rows.name: Dholavira: A Harappan City
rows.description: One of the most prominent archaeological sites of Indus Valley Civilization. Features sophisticated water management and urban planning.
